title: Uniform definitions over every parameter set need a small-set convention.
details: In the2017-08-27 version, Definition2.18(4) p.14 and Proposition2.22/Theorem2.23(3) p.15 require one fixed formula psi(y;z) whose instances with parameters from every arbitrary A define every local phi-type over A. Take the stable equality formula phi(x;y)=(x=y) in an infinite pure-equality structure and A={a}. The two consistent local types x=a and x≠a give opposite traces on A. For any fixed finite parameter length, A has only one tuple, so a single psi has only one such instance and cannot define both traces. Repair: permit a finite family of defining schemes, or state the necessary at-least-two-element/coding convention for merging schemes. Ordinary individual A-definability is unaffected. The corpus selected over-model theorem asserts individual definitions, not this unqualified uniform schema.
